title: AI 今日结构性变化信号
core_insight: 今日新增的AI信息中，技术层变化较为显著，包括新范式的提出和模型能力边界的推进，同时基础设施、应用层和资本信号也呈现出一定的变化

dimension_texts.technology: POLAR-Bench提出了一种新的benchmark，用于评估LLM的隐私保护能力 GraphDiffMed提出了一种新的图神经网络架构，用于药物推荐 POLAR-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in LLM Agents GraphDiffMed: Knowledge-Constrained Differential Attention with Pharmacological Graph Priors for Medication Recommendation
dimension_texts.infrastructure: LEAP提出了一种新的闭环框架，用于发现新材料 GROW提出了一种新的多任务学习框架，用于视觉语言模型 LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery GROW: Aligning GRPO with State-Action Modeling for Open-World VLM Agents
dimension_texts.application: Spotify和Universal Music合作，允许用户创建AI生成的歌曲 Hark提出了一种新的AI接口，用于多模态交互 Spotify and Universal Music strike deal allowing fan-made AI covers and remixes Hark raises $700M Series A for its secretive ‘universal’ AI interface
dimension_texts.capital: Hark获得7亿美元A轮融资，用于开发其AI接口 Spotify和Universal Music合作，允许用户创建AI生成的歌曲 Google DeepMind推出了一种新的AI加速器计划，用于支持环境风险研究 Hark raises $700M Series A for its secretive ‘universal’ AI interface We’re launching the Google DeepMind Accelerator program in Asia Pacific to tackle environmental risks
dimension_texts.risk: Trump推迟了AI安全行政命令的签署 The Path提出了一种新的AI治疗平台，用于提供更安全的AI治疗 With aluminum prices up 20%, recycling startups bet on AI to cash in Trump delays AI security executive order, saying language ‘could have been a blocker’ The Path, founded by Tony Robbins and Calm alums, hopes to offer safer AI therapy
